title: What's New: Concurrency in Warehousing (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: How warehouse posting works until now
New concurrent posting approach in BC25
Insert record function and sift bucket handling
Drill down filtering and event hooks

features.name: Concurrent warehouse entry posting
features.description: Multiple users can now post warehouse entries at the same time, replacing the previous single-user-at-a-time model. This is achieved using number sequences instead of table locks and manual entry numbering.
caveats: Sift index contention can still occur with same item and location combinations

features.name: Number sequences for entry numbering
features.description: Entry numbers are now assigned via a number sequence function instead of manual lock and find last operations, enabling parallel posting without blocking.

features.name: Insert record function
features.description: New function called insert record replaces simple insert operations to handle cases where old-style locking code still exists and to manage number sequence resets on insertion conflicts.
caveats: Must handle reset of number sequence on insertion failure

features.name: Sift bucket number assignment
features.description: A semi-random sift bucket number between zero and four is assigned to warehouse entries to reduce lock contention on sift indexes when multiple users insert entries for the same item and location combination.
caveats: Only reduces risk, does not completely eliminate sift index contention

features.name: On init event for warehouse entries
features.description: Event hook called after warehouse entry initialization but before insertion, allowing extensions to create additional entries or perform custom logic with access to entry number and warehouse register information.
caveats: Extensions using this event may need to implement similar concurrent posting patterns

features.name: Concurrent posting feature key
features.description: A feature key controls the new concurrent posting behavior and is enabled by default. Can be disabled if needed through warehouse setup configuration.
caveats: Feature key provides backward compatibility option
